title: The Grunion Run, 2019 · before
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · the aggregator
logline: The day before the twenty-second run: nine lanterns on the counter, and the girl, nine, with her notebook from two years ago open to 'the fish moved / the people did,' and asking Wood which one was true. He says both. She writes 'both' and underlines it, and looks at him like that's cheating.

panels.composition: The shack. Nine lanterns. The GIRL with an old notebook open. WOOD on the stool. The PUP.

balloons.text: 'The fish moved. The people did.' Which one was true?
